title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode7 Filled With These Wishes

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
So this is Mita's new song.
I've been thinking for a while now that he produces some pretty good stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally feels like Kotaro, you know? And it's really easy listening because he isn't trying to do anything too complicated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree. Mita's song provides a nice contrast to EVER's more straight-up rock sound.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He seems to have taken a pop approach with his sound selection, and he's done a good job of nailing everything down. Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, we're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He appears to have used less sound in some parts to make way for these gaps. His goal must be to use these parts to get the listener more excited.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he's placed the audience at the forefront. It's like he trying to reach out to them through his music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that Mita had no trouble with the theme we decided.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After all, he's very good at interacting with the audience. He wants the listener to hear a certain thing and react a certain way...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As much as I want my song to move someone's heart, I never once thought about who I'm trying to reach.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I decided that I was going to make my own track, I wanted you guys to feel something special when you listened to it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I chose to turn the moment I met An for the first time into a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My goal was to express the incredible joy and excitement I've felt every single day since she introduced me to the world of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Azusawa said something similar.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, where does that place me?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(What is my sound about?
Who am I writing this song for?)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go next.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You never cease to amaze.
It's powerful and very striking, but the finer details are also worth noting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How did you put your new song together so quickly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, after saying that it was coming along “okay” just the other day. It sounded essentially complete.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, it probably doesn't need much work. Meanwhile, Mita, myself and my team still have a lot left to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're in the same boat...
Not only that, Arata's track is really good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've captured what's trending right now, but it also naturally meshes well with your own style.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it's a simple sound with no complicated bells or whistles attached. You made this with a clear goal in mind, and you did it in a clever way...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We gotta keep doing what we can for our demo.
The next day
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...is how practice went yesterday.
The others' new songs seem to be coming along well.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, and you guys don't have much time left until your next event.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
And you're here helping me.
Even though it's crunch time for you guys right now. I kinda feel bad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, please don't feel bad. I'm the one who initially asked you to do this.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, having you help me like this has been pretty huge.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: The ideas I've been coming up with have been really fine and detailed, which meant that I needed to figure out a way to express them...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And you inputted all the right sounds before I even said anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well... That may be because I'm getting more used to how you undergo this process, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
This is more than good intuition.
You totally have a talent for this.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I couldn't have asked for a better assistant. If it were just me working on this, Aoyagi, I probably wouldn't even be halfway done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad that I could be of so much help. It's also been a wonderful learning experience for me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Really? It doesn't feel like I've been doing much teaching... But it'd be really great if this song ends up being as good as what the others are making.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I bet they all came up with some really good ones. Am I right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Tono's song felt especially powerful. He managed to capture such an aggressive sound.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Whoa, he wrote that kind of song?!
Vivid BAD SQUAD's not gonna let him hog all the glory, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About that... I want to do the song Akito and Shiraishi are writing justice by putting on the best performance I can.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It's scary because you can't let your guard down. I felt the same way when we formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, since Arata was always the better performer. He definitely stood out more than me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I didn't want him to hog the spotlight, so I always did my best to make myself heard after he got the crowd's attention.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Even though I knew that Arata was out of this world, I also wanted to shine.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, he said he really liked the suggestions I made for this one track I talked to him about.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He told me, “I like this, Soma. I want to try singing it.”

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was when I realized how my tracks were and are still meant for Arata. Whenever he feels motivated to sing something, he always puts on a mind-blowing performance.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Remember how you said you want to be more of a contributor, Aoyagi? I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I want to help Arata as much as I can, and I decided to finish the track I was working on before my accident.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even now, you see Tono as the invaluable partner you can't be without.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: No, that's not true.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm not Arata's partner anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Because this body of mine is keeping me from singing or standing on the same stage as him.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm even making this song for Arata to sing. Unlike in the past, I can't perform it while standing next to him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is that really true...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Based on what I've heard, this song didn't give me that impression...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
I may be jumping to the wrong conclusion...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means you have the power to truly understand what a person's music is about, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really happy when you said that you understood how I felt, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard otherwise... This song told me that you still want to perform alongside Tono.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt this desire to keep chasing after the person in front of you. To go wherever you can together and keep pushing each other to higher ground. That's what I took away from your song...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I understand...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is also the reason why I can't make them wait more than they need to. I want to show them some good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma's wishing for the same thing.
That explains why this song resonated with me so much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I too have a partner that I can't be without. That may be why I was able to arrive at this conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see...
